method.foreground: Computed CSS foreground resolved through canvas, including alpha. Text shadows/strokes/filters/blends excluded.
method.background: Actual DPR1 background-only PNG, created by transient browser-only text-color masking that preserves element geometry. Original render also retained.
method.solid: Premultiplied source-over group composition models every ancestor background and opacity; compared with >=99.5% interior screenshot pixels within1.5 RGB channel units.
method.complex: With no group opacity, un-antialiased CSS foreground is composed against every sampled RGB background inside visible text rectangles; report minimum conservative ratio. Transparent opacity groups without inner background/image paint allow foreground alpha multiplied by group opacity against actual background pixels.
method.limits: Alpha is browser-canvas8bit resolved; subpixel edges excluded by2px inset. Unresolvable complex + opacity, partially occluded range grid, shadows/filters remain unverified. No glyph antialias ratio or complete a11y assertion.
method.criteria: Text minimum4.5; large24px or18.6667px700 weight minimum3. Disabled ratios recorded without conformance pass. Pale auxiliary text stays subject to measured threshold; visual preference is not an exception.
